NORTHWIND RETAIL  London, UK | Apr 2019 - Feb 2021
Frontend Engineer
Multi-brand e-commerce retailer.
- Moved the product pages to server-side rendering, lifting Lighthouse scores from 60 to 90 without losing search traffic.
- Worked with four product teams to migrate shared UI patterns into a single design system.
Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Lighthouse, SEO tooling.
roleDescription: Frontend Performance Engineer, Ashgrove Media. Tell us about a time you dramatically improved a slow site.
instructions: Write a tailored cover letter using only the CV's own numbers. Do not restate 'from 60 to 90' as a percentage or any other derived figure.
expectedFacts: lifted Lighthouse scores from 60 to 90 without losing search traffic at Northwind Retail
